context:
Goal: the next project goes faster because lessons from past repos reach it.
Problem (goal): an Opus critic read the plan and says build smaller. The plan checks every write, but nothing makes a session read the book, so it grows unread. Its counts are stale (main is 1321 commits past its base).
Based on (read): decision test-practices already holds 12 cross-repo testing practices, and the builder, reviewer and test-author files read it. The plan would move part of it to a new home that no agent file reads.
Based on (read): q_max, joyous and ios-adblock have no roadmap outbox, so their lessons have no way in.
Based on (measured): no count shows the "faster" goal; the pace numbers already exist and the plan uses none.
Departs from: main — adds one practices record beside test-practices and one read line in agents/plan.md and the brief template, in place of the plan's select.py, shape check, feed and cull.

Meanwhile: no lane starts on #1034.
holds: Every shivpedia lane: the new skill, the glossary move, and the 16 prose moves.

lastAnswer.note: send a critic opus agent on this plan

options.gain: Lessons reach plans now, at about one read line of cost; you see whether anyone uses them before paying for the full build.
options.how: Keep test-practices as the testing chapter. Add one sibling record (merging practices) with evidence from several repos. Add one read line to agents/plan.md and the brief template. Collect lessons by hand for two weeks from reviewer findings and owner corrections. Then count cites and repeats.
options.label: Build the small proof
options.lose: No automatic feed for two weeks; the full plan waits on the count.

options.gain: The whole feed, check and cull land at once.
options.how: Re-count the plan at main, then build it as written.
options.label: Build the plan as written, after a fresh re-count
options.lose: The read gap stays; testing advice gets two homes; three repos feed nothing; cost per turn unmeasured.

options.label: Park the plan and close #1034
options.lose: Lessons keep living only in debts, notes and memory.

ref: draft PR #1034, docs/plans/prose-homes-shivpedia.md; roadmap step craft-book
title: How should the shivpedia plan proceed?
why: Recommended: a. Lessons reach plans now at the cost of one read line, and the two-week count shows whether the full build is worth it.
